title: Isolation and culture of mouse alveolar type II cells to study type II to type I cell differentiation
protocol: Perfuse the lung with 10 mL PBS via the pulmonary artery.
Inject 2 mL dispase into the lung through the trachea followed by 0.5 mL melted agarose (2% in PBS) (~45°C).
Immediately cover the lung with ice for 2 min to let the agarose solidify and seal the upper airways.
Tie the trachea and remove the lung from the mouse using forceps.
Incubate the lung in 0.5 mL dispase in a 15 mL tube for 45 min at 20°C–25°C.
Transfer the lung to a 60 mm tissue culture dish containing 5 mL of HEPES-buffered DMEM with 100 unit/mL DNase I.
Gently tease the lung tissue into small pieces (smaller than 2 mm³) from the bronchi.
Cut 2–3 mm from the tip of a 1 mL pipette tip and use it to pipette the tissue pieces up and down to further dissociate the cells.
Incubate the cells at 20°C–25°C for 10 min.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer and then nylon gauze (20 μm pore size) to get single-cell suspension in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 1 ml of additional HEPES-buffered DMEM to collect residual cells after serial filtration, filter through the same cell strainer.
Centrifuge cells at 130 × g for 8 min at 4°C in a centrifuge suitable for 15 mL centrifuge tubes.
Re-suspend cells in 5 mL HEPES-buffered DMEM.
Place cells in tissue culture plates coated with CD45 and CD32 antibodies.
Incubate cells at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 1 h.
Add an additional aliquot of DNase I directly to the plate if cell aggregates are observed.
Gently rock and swirl the plate to evenly disperse DNase I into the medium.
Incubate the plate for another 10 min after adding DNase I.
Transfer suspending cells from the plate into a 15 mL tube.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 130 × g for 8 min.
Re-suspend cells in 1 mL RBC lysis buffer and transfer to 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes.
Incubate cells on ice for 1 min.
Spin down cells at 400 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Wash cells in PBS twice.
Re-suspend cells in 250 μL of FACS buffer (PBS + 2% FBS).
Incubate the suspension with 4 μL of biotin conjugated anti-EpCAM antibody for 45 min on a rotator at 4°C.
Spin down the cells at 400 × g for 3 min and re-suspend in 1 mL FACS buffer to wash.
Repeat the washing step twice, spinning down and resuspending cells each time with 1 mL of FACS buffer.
After the last wash, re-suspend cells in 500 μL FACS buffer.
Add 20 μL of streptavidin conjugated magnetic beads to the cells and incubate for 30 min at 4°C with rotation.
Wash cells twice using MACS buffer (1× PBS, 0.5% BSA, 2 mM EDTA-pH 7.2).
Resuspend washed cells in 500 μL of MACS buffer.
Arrange tubes containing resuspended cells on a magnetic rack for separation.
Let the cells bind to the magnetic rack for 8 min on ice.
Remove negative/unbound fraction using a 1 mL pipette.
Re-suspend positive/bound fraction in 1 mL of MACS buffer.
Let the cells bind for 8 min.
Remove negative/unbound fraction with a 1 mL pipette.
Repeat cell binding for 8 min.
Remove negative/unbound fraction again with a 1 mL pipette.
Stain the cells with trypan blue dye.
Determine viability and yield of the cells.
Centrifuge cells onto glass slides using a cytospin centrifuge.
Re-suspend 2–5 × 10^4 cells in 150 μL PBS.
Spin for 5 min at 500 rpm (28 × g).
Dry the cells for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Circle the cells on slides with a hydrophobic pen.
Fix cells in 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) at 20°C–25°C for 15 min.
Wash slides in PBS three times.
Stain cells with antibody against type II cell marker Sp-C using general immunofluorescence staining procedures.
Inject 0.5 mL agarose (2% in PBS) (~45°C) after the dispase.
Use a relatively slow speed (130 × g) for initial centrifugations to remove most type I cells.
Store cytospin slides in PBS at 4°C for about a week after fixation.
Sort type II cells using FACS with gates for forward, side scatter, DAPI, and lineage markers.
Place a 15 mm round glass coverslip in each well of a 24-well plate.
Coat coverslips or wells with 250 μL of 0.2% gelatin.
Incubate coated plates for 1–18 hours at 37°C.
Pipette off the gelatin solution and allow the coverslips or culture wells to dry for at least 2 hours inside a tissue culture hood.
Resuspend isolated type II cell pellet in media (HEPES-buffered DMEM).
Plate 150,000–200,000 type II cells per well using 500 μL of resuspended cells.
For S1P treatment experiments, add charcoal stripped FBS instead of regular FBS in cell culture medium.
Let type II cells sit for 48 h without disturbing them.
Change the medium after letting the cells sit for 48 hours.
Make S1P stock solution in ethanol at 1 mM and store it at -20°C.
Aliquot enough S1P solution needed for the experiment from the stock.
Evaporate ethanol under inert gas (nitrogen or argon) to dry S1P.
Reconstitute dried S1P to 125 μM in 4 mg/mL fatty acid free BSA made in sterile water.
Add S1P to cell culture medium containing charcoal stripped FBS to a final concentration of 1 μM.
Change half of the medium (250 μL per well) every day with freshly made S1P.
Keep the plate flat and add fresh medium slowly along the side of the culture wells to minimize disturbance to the cells.
Dilute 20 mM JTE-013 in culture medium containing 10% FBS to a final concentration of 10 μM for treatment.
Add an equivalent volume of DMSO to control wells.
Change the medium after 2 days for treated cells.
Fix cells with 4% PFA for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Remove PFA and gently wash the cells with 1 mL PBS.
Proceed with antibody staining for type I cell markers HopX and Ager.
Lysate the cells in 1 mL Trizol for RNA extraction using an RNA extraction kit.
Proceed with qRT-PCR to assess the expression of AT1 and AT2 marker genes, such as Sp-C for AT2 cells and HopX and Ager for AT1 cells.
Pellet cells and re-suspend sorted type II cells at 100 cells/μL in 3D culture media.
Trypsinize the cultured Mlg cells and re-suspend at 2,000 cells/μL in 3D culture media.
Thaw Matrigel on ice at 4°C for several hours.
In sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, add 100 μL of the thawed Matrigel + 50 μL of Mlg (@100,000 cells/well) + 50 μL of type II (@5,000 cells/well).
Mix the cells and Matrigel well.
Plate the mixture (total 200 μL) in Transwell inserts.
Incubate the plates for 30 min in a tissue culture incubator to solidify the Matrigel.
Add 600 μL of warm 3D culture medium to the lower chamber.
Grow cells in inserts for up to three weeks and change medium every other day.
Observe Tomato+ or GFP+ colonies in the Matrigel.
Discard the culture medium from the Transwell inserts.
Add 600 μL of 4% PFA at 20°C–25°C to the wells.
Fix cells at 20°C–25°C for 20 minutes.
Further fix cells at 4°C for 2 days.
Carefully peel off the membrane from the bottom of the Transwell insert after fixation.
Remove the Matrigel plug from the Transwell insert gently.
Add 10 μM JTE-013 to purified type II cells before mixing with Matrigel.
Add 10 μM JTE-013 to the 3D culture medium in the wells.
Change the medium every other day, adding fresh JTE-013.
